scope: Read-only source, frozen F contract and plan review; synthetic tests only. No market classification, label join, detector, simulator or scoring was run by this reviewer.

checks.phase_separation: classify parses only the candidate registry, original stored state fields and original signal identity; labels and detections are first parsed in join after a completed classification receipt and exact SHA. Source/plan/test/preflight must match committed HEAD.
checks.source_authentication: Both frozen F receipts are SHA-pinned; all referenced input/source/artifact bytes are verified before use and again before completion. Round-trip CSV floats preserve frozen numerical identity.
checks.candidate_conservation: The original 10386 candidates are selected by the unchanged UTC study window, verified against 278 instrument metadata/scheduled state files, and outer one-to-one joined to the exact V3 early stream using original index, time and close.
checks.frozen_interval: Both prior12 boundaries come from candidate t. The high is cross-checked against all stored original V3/F frozen-high fields. The rolling t+1 interval is never used.
checks.partition: Known finite valid intervals classify close > high as above, low <= close <= high as inside, and close < low as below. Both equalities are inside. Unknown F status or invalid original interval is unknown. Summaries validate category membership, duplicate identities and exhaustive totals.
checks.clocks_unknowns: Original t must be pending and match stored candidate identity. An observed adjudication is exactly the next stored row; a known decision must close precisely one hour after t. Gaps and invalid next OHLC preserve F unknown reasons; terminal unavailable decisions retain missing observation time, not a fabricated t+1 price. available_at_candidate is false.
checks.label_identity: Original V3 event_i + first_signal_lag maps timely positives to original candidates, not F acceptance/publication rows. Exact original clocks are checked. All 8046 study anchors remain, including negative and unknown labels; 1660 positives, 1463 timely positives and 947 large positives are fixed and asserted.
checks.denominator_honesty: The 14904 source labels remain authenticated unchanged. Within-study output retains 8046 original anchors. The 947 large-positive partition explicitly includes not_caught; 1463 timely positives are not a win-rate denominator.
checks.fixed_cases: HYPE/PEPE 2026-08-19 21:00 BJT and NEAR 2026-08-19 15:00 BJT were specified before this classification. Their selection does not depend on new location counts.
checks.integrity_negative_controls: Synthetic checks reject tampered hashes, frozen high, identity, observed clocks, status/price contradictions, missing joins, non-timely lag, duplicate candidates and overwrites.
checks.no_strategy_change: No detector, label generator, simulator, new feature selection, threshold change or execution import is introduced. Original F, V1/V3 comparisons and prior success/failure gates are unchanged.

limitations: This is a descriptive reread of already observed, authorized history, not blind out-of-sample validation.
Inside means only that the next close lies in the original interval. It is not sufficient evidence of normal retest, continuing trend, winning trade or a usable new filter.
Below is a price location, not a trade failure label. Unknown is not rejection or noise.
Classification trusts the authenticated and previously audited F OHLC-adjudication contract; it does not rerun OHLC validation or a detector.

All non-timely anchors remain in joined output, but location joins are deliberately defined only for original timely positive hits. Do not infer class-conditional precision or profitability from the timely-positive table.
Cross-symbol market episodes and rolling anchors within a trend are dependent observations; these counts do not establish an independent success rate.
This receipt approves only the frozen descriptive build after the exact reviewed files and receipt are committed. No market build or native TradingView compilation is claimed.
